# Market Update

Report 056 | Published 2021-05-16 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-5-16/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/056.json)

Commodity rotation and bitcoin correction scenarios.

The specific higher-high-in-2021 bitcoin base case was correct despite a severe interim drawdown. The surrounding broad downside/upside scenarios should not add separate wins. Commodity and inflation decade theses remain open, while the undated sector preferences are shown with explicit return sensitivities.

**Coverage:** Read the entire brief update. Retained the dated bitcoin base case, alternative paths, producer preferences and retrospective trade claims. Personal transaction statements are not assumed to be independently audited; public newsletter links are outside this article unless separately included in the corpus.
